newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Grp sells Berjaya Industrial shrs.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Grp sells Berjaya Industrial shrs.

text.p: Berjaya Group Bhd said on Tuesday that it is proposing to sell 32 percent of its 40 percent stake in Berjaya Industrial Bhd to Linksun Avenue Sdn Bhd for 568.06 million ringgit in cash.
In a statement, the diversified property firm said the proposed sale involves 162.30 million Berjaya Industrial shares for 3.50 ringgit a share.
Berjaya Industrial is involved in management services as well as operating hotels. Linksun is a privately-held company involved in investment holding, the statement said.
The sale of the 32 percent stake will realise an extraordinary gain of about 128.4 million ringgit for Berjaya Group, the company said.

Berjaya Group said the proposed divestment allows it to realise its investment in Berjaya Industrial "at an attractive price". It said the proceeds would be used to repay debt and for working capital needs.
After completion of the proposed divestment, Berjaya Group and its wholly-owned unit Juara Sejati Sdn Bhd will collectively hold 127.93 million or about 25.22 percent of Berjaya Industrial.
Berjaya Group said it intends to eventually divest or place out all these shares "to realise the potential capital gain in full".
Berjaya Group and Berjaya Industrial shares last traded at 1.81 ringgit and 2.12 ringgit, respectively on November 25 prior to a suspension in trading.
